title: Itinerary warning settings
preconditions: npm run seed, npm start. Start from a saved itinerary with arrival and departure set at least 2 hours apart.
cleanup: npm run clear:itinerary-config, then reload Itinerary.

steps.name: Clear confirmation skips
steps.do: From the project root, run `npm run clear:itinerary-config`, then reload **Itinerary**.
steps.expect: Command reports no **Don't show this again** skips (or clears any that were on).

steps.name: Open settings
steps.do: Click the gear in the top-right of the itinerary map.
steps.expect: A **Settings** overlay opens at itinerary-builder size, with **Save**, and three checked warnings: **Short Visit?**, **Early Admission Hours**, and **Add to Itinerary?**.

steps.name: Close with unsaved change
steps.expect: **Save Changes?** appears (same chrome as the builder), with **Save** and **Discard**.

steps.name: Discard
steps.expect: Settings closes. The gear remains on the map.

steps.name: Discarded change did not persist
steps.do: On Day Planner, set arrival and departure less than **2 hours** apart (e.g. **10:00 AM** and **11:00 AM**).

steps.name: Confirm short visit
steps.do: On **Short Visit?**, leave **Don’t show this again** unchecked and confirm.
steps.expect: Times are saved. The confirmation closes.

steps.name: Lengthen the visit
steps.do: Set arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **2:00 PM**.
steps.expect: Times are kept. **Short Visit?** does not appear.

steps.name: Save uncheck
steps.do: Open the gear, uncheck **Short Visit?**, and click **Save**.

steps.name: Saved uncheck stays quiet
steps.do: Set arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **11:00 AM**.
steps.expect: **Short Visit?** does not appear. The times are saved.

steps.name: Restore Short Visit
steps.do: Open the gear, check **Short Visit?**, and click **Save**.
steps.expect: Settings closes. **Short Visit?** is checked if you reopen.

steps.name: Short visit asks again
steps.do: Set arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **2:00 PM**, then change departure to **11:00 AM**.
steps.expect: **Short Visit?** confirmation appears, with **Don't show this again**.

steps.name: Don't show this again
steps.do: Check **Don't show this again** on that confirmation and confirm.
steps.expect: Times are saved. Open the gear: **Short Visit?** is unchecked.

steps.name: Day Planner still usable
steps.do: Close settings if it is open (Save or **×**) and use Day Planner.
